goal: Implement domain-check: a CLI that reports whether domains are registered or available via RDAP with DNS fallback, with bulk input and schema-conformant JSON output.
done_when: All units U1-U8 have status=done, checks/verify.sh passes offline, and checks/verify.sh --live passes against real RDAP/DNS.

rules: Pick the first pending unit whose dependencies are all done; set it in_progress.
Only touch files listed in the unit's allowed_paths (plus this ledger). manifest_guard.py enforces this.
A unit is done only when its acceptance command passes AND checks/verify.sh does not regress previously-done units.
Never edit files under tests/, tests_live/, checks/, or schema/ — the baseline gate is immutable during the loop.
On acceptance failure, increment attempts; at max_attempts mark the unit failed and halt.

units.title: CLI skeleton: argument parsing, usage, version, exit codes
Domain validation and normalization (case, trailing dot, IDN/punycode)
RDAP client: IANA bootstrap, lookup, status classification
DNS fallback probe (NS lookup, NXDOMAIN handling)
Verdict engine combining RDAP and DNS signals with confidence
Bulk mode: many domains, order-preserving, per-domain error isolation
JSON results output conforming to schema/results.schema.json, wired into the CLI
Packaging and docs: console entry point, README usage

stall.on_stall: Halt the loop, mark the unit failed, and surface the diff plus failing test output for human review.

cost_envelope.notes: One unit per iteration; the verify gate must pass for a unit before it is marked done.

provenance: Baseline authored best-effort in a cloud session without access to the original LOOP-domaincheck.md spec (local file was unreachable); scope confirmed with the user as an availability-checker CLI.
